creativeRules: Preserve genuine Red Oak food, people, venue and product photography; do not generatively reconstruct source subjects.
Use exact approved logo artwork without redrawing it.
Use photo-led layouts, bold condensed display hierarchy, charcoal/black grounding, vivid red accents and warm oak texture.
Use rough or hand-drawn accent graphics sparingly; keep product photography dominant and legible at mobile size.
Do not invent prices, dates, menu claims, sponsors or event details.
Canva is a discovery and optional editing/output surface, not the permanent brand database.
limitations: The Canva title and subtitle fonts are not currently available as licensed local files on the MSI; portable/PSD proofs must disclose substitutions until CG supplies or licenses them.

The Canva connector cannot start an editing transaction on the 444-page NEW RED OAK ADS 2025 design; use representative read-only inspection, a small copied design, or independent composition instead.
No offer is approved by this pack. All proof offers must be clearly fictional and internal.
